entries.0774719bcf96829b: This business is handled by domestic subsidiaries. It provides services related to barrier-free subtitle and audio guide production, barrier-free consulting, and film distribution. As the company transferred HIKE Co., Ltd. and Akuapurasu Co., Ltd. during the current fiscal year and advanced its withdrawal from this business, net sales for the fiscal year ended January 2026 declined significantly to ¥2,139 million.
entries.0b03735d6bbc0a0e: A holding company that provides solutions supporting each stage of service development and operation, such as game debugging and software testing.

entries.0e78a566d9979044: The company provides quality consulting, game debugging, software testing, environment setup and migration support, monitoring, customer support, fraud countermeasures, BPR support and other services across each stage from service planning to improvement.
entries.12a4f1c14249350b: The current consolidated fiscal year is described as the final year of the four-year restructuring period the company set, and as having completed business restructuring, including withdrawal from the media and content business. Domestic and overseas solutions posted higher revenue, but because media and content revenue dropped off, consolidated revenue fell 6.5% year on year to ¥48,837 million. The description placed under priority issues to address states that profitability is expected to improve from the following fiscal year onward, due to the effects of business structural reform.
entries.1385de123fc9320a: This business is mainly handled by overseas subsidiaries.
entries.3bbe2ee63cfda124: Its mission is to solve customers' challenges by combining people and technology, and it states that it will enhance synergies among group companies in Japan and overseas and promote further globalization and expansion of business areas. In its business strategy, it aims for full-process support through group collaboration and growth in the Tech field, a large market, in domestic solutions, and improved profitability through rebuilding the business base in overseas solutions. It will withdraw from the media and content business and allocate management resources to domestic software testing and development, overseas business expansion, and efforts to apply AI to operations, among others. After completing the restructuring period, it will shift to a re-growth phase, and it aims to record profit attributable to owners of parent in the following fiscal year.
entries.44c4b4071c559cab: Net loss attributable to owners of parent for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥3,479 million. Net loss for the previous year was also ¥692 million.
entries.4cbff72937cc28ca: Through its domestic and overseas subsidiaries, the company provides solution services tailored to challenges in each stage of its customers' services and products: planning, development, release, operation and improvement.
entries.5bb12d005e161057: Revenue from media and content business
entries.5beba212351c6a56: It is described as a pioneer in the debugging, software testing and monitoring industries, having built transaction records with many customer companies since its founding and having sought to accumulate know-how and diversify services. In addition, its capability to address the entire service lifecycle, covering all stages from service planning to improvement, and its global delivery structure, in which overseas subsidiaries' brands are unified under 'Side', form the foundation of its business.
entries.82845c6da17d5eac: The company has a single segment, the Service Lifecycle Solutions Business. Revenue by business is ¥25,904 million for domestic solutions, ¥20,792 million for overseas solutions, and ¥2,139 million for media and content. Revenue by region is ¥29,799 million for Japan, ¥9,274 million for the United States, ¥4,576 million for Asia, ¥4,674 million for Europe and ¥512 million for other regions, and no customer is stated to account for 10% or more of consolidated revenue.

entries.8f2c52bc12a9acbb: The group consists of the company, 39 consolidated subsidiaries and 1 affiliate, and provides solution services tailored to challenges in each stage of customers' service and product lifecycles: planning, development, release, operation and improvement. It has a single segment, divided into three businesses: Domestic Solutions, Overseas Solutions and Media and Content. Consolidated net sales for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥48,837 million, and the number of consolidated employees was 2,953.
entries.a1ccff6b85dc6835: The company earns revenue through service provision in its domestic solutions, overseas solutions and media and content businesses. Consolidated revenue for the fiscal year ended January 2026 was ¥48,837 million, down 6.5% year on year.
entries.ac170f4526e42901: This business is mainly handled by overseas subsidiaries. It provides services related to game debugging, localization, voice recording, customer support, product development support, and graphics development. Revenue increased owing to a recovery in the overseas game industry environment, an increase in voice recording work and the effect of the weaker yen, and net sales for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥20,792 million.
entries.adcd89b5b7c94959: This business is handled by domestic subsidiaries. For the game market, it provides game debugging, customer support, localization and overseas expansion support; for the Tech market, software testing, environment setup and system development; and for the E-commerce market, monitoring and customer support. Revenue increased owing to Nintendo Switch 2-related work and higher labor unit prices in the domestic game market, and net sales for the fiscal year ended January 2026 were ¥25,904 million.
entries.c6d8d963aa067071: The company's main customers are software development companies and internet site operators, among others, and it provides services to companies in the game, Tech and E-commerce markets.
